derivation:
by
  ext g
  simpa [fixingSubgroup, _root_.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff, Set.ext_iff] using (MulAction.fixedBy_eq_univ_iff_eq_one (α := M) (m := g))
explanation: For a faithful action, Mathlib says an element fixes the whole space exactly when it is the identity. Specializing to the diffeomorphism action and applying subgroup extensionality gives the result.
